assumptions: PR #3338 is closed unmerged; its fail-fast work does not cover the findBusyReviewers error-reporting defect, which is present on origin/main.
Open ready PRs #3396 (draft) and #3506 (merged) previously touched the protected script; #3396 is draft so it does not block the protected-source collision check.
goal: Make the reviewer lease probe carry the real cause of a failed read (which read failed, which ref, the transport/parse error, transient vs determinate) on the refusal instead of collapsing every failure into "active reviewer leases are unreadable", without weakening fail-closed behavior (#3349).
prohibited_actions: Do not change any database structure, migration, view, function, trigger, or live row.
Do not weaken fail-closed behavior: every current return-null path in findBusyReviewers must still refuse.
Do not raise REVIEW_REF_ROW_LIMIT or retire any ref.
Do not touch production, workflows, or secrets.
stop_conditions: Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
Stop if any existing test asserting fail-closed refusal starts passing because the refusal disappeared.
